Delhi AQI 3036: What Did We Find on the Ground?
An AQI reading of 3036 was reported from MBS Nagar Road, Chaukhandi, Tilak Nagar Delhi, on Diwali night. How did the reading reach such an extraordinary level? What was the actual condition of the air on the ground? And what does this number really mean?
The official Indian AQI scale, maintained under CPCB's framework, ranges from 0 to 500. So how did a reading above 3000 appear on an air-quality platform?
